name: Kusunoki Kiyoka
source:
The only daughter of the world-renowned Kusunoki Group and a young businesswoman. Despite being a student, Kiyoka herself is the president of a famous cosmetics company and is a wealthy person.

She met [url=/c130648]Haruki[/url] (who was cross-dressing at the time) when she was young, and even though they were separated due to some circumstances, such as Haruki moving away, she always has feelings for him.

"Standing beautifully like a peony, sitting beautifully like a peony, walking beautifully like a lily." Like an embodiment of these words, attractive, beautiful, smart, well-mannered, and soft-spoken, a perfect [i]ojousama[/i]. ――Other people tend to feel that way judging from her appearance, but the truth is, she tends to do what her heart desires. Often behaves strangely, doing whatever she feels like to achieve her goal, a wasted beauty.

She is honest and hard-working. "If it's something that you really wants, no matter what the others say, you should be honest with your own heart." This is what she believes, and her behavior is also based on it.

At an early age, she had to closed off her heart in order to fulfill her role as the "Daughter of Kusunoki Group." Hiding her true feelings and faking herself were things that she had to do everyday. Eventually, they became normal for her, but all of those changed during the summer of her sixth grade, when she met Haruki after his idol audition.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1251783]Getchu[/url]]
